contract.purpose: Canonical registry of every environment knob agent/agent.py reads. One source, so the fingerprint's component list, the axis registry and the documentation cannot drift apart -- they did: the fingerprint tracked 26 of 47 knobs and four of those names did not exist, so a merge that added three knobs passed it unchanged.
contract.rule: semantic=true means the knob can change what the agent does, so it belongs in the optimizer fingerprint. semantic=false keeps it out of the fingerprint, and covers two different reasons: diagnostics/telemetry, and knobs that are parsed but INERT because nothing reads the value they feed. Inert knobs carry a `note` saying so -- they are not telemetry, and the note is what stops the next reader from tuning them. A knob absent from this file fails tests/test_knob_registry.py -- adding an env read to agent.py requires registering it here and deciding its axis.
contract.projection_warning: A fingerprint sees only P(Theta), the registered projection. P(Theta)=P(Theta') does not imply Theta=Theta'. This registry is what keeps the projection total over env knobs. It used to exclude source literals such as the Ranker weights on the grounds that they were not settable; that hole is closed as of 2026-08-03 -- RANKER_WEIGHTS, CONSTRUCTIVE_ORDER_WEIGHTS and STABILITY_PROXY_WEIGHTS now expose those seventeen coefficients as vectors. Any weight vector added in future must be exposed the same way, or the function carrying it is invisible to every drift catcher in the repository.

CONSTRUCTIVE_ORDER_WEIGHTS.note: The four coefficients of constructive_order, which seeds the offline order search. Same history and same reasoning as RANKER_WEIGHTS. Measured: this blend is the WORST start in 2 of 3 seeds against single-quantity sorts.

OFFLINE_FILL_WEIGHT.note: INERT. Feeds only DryRunResult.weighted_score (agent.py:941), which has no call sites anywhere in the repository. The offline order search accepts a neighbour on DryRunResult.rank_key (agent.py:6350), a lexicographic tuple that does not consult either weight. Verified by ablation: 0.65/0.35, 0.0/1.0 and 99.0/-99.0 all give behaviour_sha256 a92092c2272df53636fe3b84ac75a9ca7cd6eaefe42c44c7718bb1bdff292b70. Do not tune this expecting an effect; change rank_key instead.

OFFLINE_RANDOM_SEED.note: Was a bare source literal until the acceptance-rule work; a search whose seed cannot be varied cannot have its variance measured, which invalidated one sweep.

OFFLINE_STABILITY_WEIGHT.note: INERT. Same mechanism as OFFLINE_FILL_WEIGHT: read only by DryRunResult.weighted_score (agent.py:941), which is never called. See that knob's note for the ablation.

RANKER_WEIGHTS.note: The eight coefficients of Ranker.score, which decides every online placement. Source literals until 2026-08-03, so unregistered and outside the fingerprint's projection: the ranker could be rewritten with no drift catcher noticing. Exposed as one vector because AGENT_OPERATIONS section 5.1 admits a free coefficient only via a pre-registered ablation, whose unit is the vector, not a per-dial tuning.

STABILITY_PROXY_WEIGHTS.note: The five coefficients of the offline stability proxy, element 4 of DryRunResult.rank_key. Same history and reasoning. Note the proxy's correlation with physical shake has never been established.
